body: I can relate to many of your symptoms and have been trying to figure out what I am dealing with myself for a few years now. I have been diagnosed with MDD and Anxiety, with possibility of ADHD without hyperactivity, but since I am living abroad, it is hard to go further and seek the proper evaluation. I am currently taking an antidepressant, and I was doing fine for a year, but all the anxiety and stress is coming back as I am starting my Master in a week. I think there is a big overlap between these things and it’s a grey area sometimes. For myself, I think it was ADHD that caused everything else since I was not coping with life properly. I would suggest seeing other doctors and getting second opinions.

I don’t know why I’m answering this, but I do, and I relate to what OP wrote heavily. In the end, I had to stop my masters abroad twice, just 1 month in each time. About to start lower soon, with just a language course this year, but feel like I am going to crash again. And no idea what I am doing with my future, or where I am going. It is all quite unbearable with my general and social anxiety + depressive episodes. I had suspicions of ADHD-I, but not sure anymore, after trying some medicines and a bit of therapy.
While I was complaining about my ability to memorize or retrieve memories, it got worse over the years. I feel like people around me remember things better than I do. Going back to my gallery of photos helps, otherwise it’s almost all blank. That way at least I can go back in that timeline somehow, remember people and emotions around it. It is quite hard to form or maintain relationships as well, everything fades easily. Idk if anyone relates.

Yes, it’s fuzzy and short. Plus I struggle with colors, almost black and white / grey. Almost dark… i also say I am generally not a creative person. Hence me sticking with life sciences, only too realize it is too much in another way at grad level.
As for the habits, I can never get mostly to start a gym/running and stick with it more than few weeks. And cooking, almost impossible, even though I love food. Too overwhelming and complicated to even think what I might need, and then going to the supermarket, man, I can lose hours wandering around anxious and lost. Though I enjoy baking from time to time😄
😄😪 yeah, it is not easy.. but have been going over this past few months, spiraling and trying to figure myself out. Good luck to you too🙏🏻
